title: 第十四章 交易第十五章 买卖之物
content_zh:
走出孤儿院时，日头已经西斜。
虽然手里没啥计时装置，但是仅从太阳的变化方位来看，此时大概是下午两点多钟。
以上次的经验来讲的话，这个剧本大概五点钟左右就会进入夜晚状态，然后强行将自己拉入到保安室之中。
不过面对这略显紧迫的时间，周游倒没有显得太过于焦急，甚至说还有点悠哉悠哉的意味。
在离开孤儿院的时候，他已经踅摸到了一根保存良好，质量过硬的麻绳，一旦没找到破关线索又见到天黑的迹象，他就会立刻找个风水宝地吊死自己。
到时候剧本重置，又是从12点开始，这时间不一下子便充裕起来了嘛。
......
.....
通过小巷，再度来到了那个十字路口。
只不过和之前相同，此处每个路口依然被深不见底的浓雾所笼罩，似乎只要人一走进，当即便会彻底的迷失方向。
如今周游也算是明白了，白天能够探索的范围和夜间探索的范围成正比，夜里他走的路越多，则白天能通过的地方越多，反之就会有浓雾阻路，告知他此路不通。
“......这倒也是好事，起码告知了我探索范围，不至于在一堆地方像是个无头苍蝇一样乱撞。”
周游如此念叨着，干净利落地转过身，朝着其他地方走去。
和夜晚那只有一条大路可以通行的情景不同，白天的街区里多了许多错综复杂的小道，其中大多在弯弯绕绕半天后只会回到起点，只有少数才会来到一些比较特殊的建筑物之前——然而基本也都是上了锁，根本就无法开启。
周游如今也没有那个闲功夫去挨个尝试，所以在仔细思索一会后，他直接选择了另一个更加高效的方法。
在第一天的时候，他就已经将门口的路线图铭记在了脑子里，所以现在他所需要做的事情很简单，就是排除掉所有与这十字路口大概无关的路线——比如XX治疗中心啊，肛肠科医院啊之类的地方——然后专心致志地找那些有可能相关，亦或者根本没有标注过的小路。
这样时间一下子便会缩短了不少。
不过说到底这依旧是瞎猫撞死耗子，一切全凭运气说话。
.......
....

跌跌撞撞尝试了整整一个小时后，周游终于碰到了个从没出现过的异常点。
——那是一扇漆黑的门扉。
门的上面并没有标注任何东西，也没有商店常见的牌匾，只是在门牌上写了一行小字。
“赵婆的交易小屋。”
下面还有一行备注。
“不欢迎任何道士和尚的光顾，不欢迎任何口袋空空的穷鬼，如以上这些人擅自闯入，则后果自负。”
顺便一提，那个‘后果自负’是用鲜红的染料所写成，边角还特地做出了流淌的痕迹，乍一看去就仿佛是由鲜血所写成的一般。
周游打量了下自己。
“首先，我不是什么宗教人员，所以没关系。”
然后又翻了翻自己的兜——不出意料的什么都没有。
content_en:
When we walked out of the orphanage, the sun was already setting.
Although I didn't have any timing device in my hand, judging from the changing position of the sun, it was probably around two o'clock in the afternoon.
Based on last experience, this script will enter the night state around five o'clock, and then forcefully pull him into the security room.
However, in the face of this slightly tight time, Zhou You didn't seem too anxious, and even said he was a little leisurely.
When he left the orphanage, he had already found a well-preserved and high-quality hemp rope. Once he found no clues to solve the problem and saw signs of darkness, he would immediately find a feng shui treasure to hang himself.
When the time comes, the script will be reset and start again at 12 o'clock, so there will be plenty of time all of a sudden.
...
.....
Passing through the alley, we came to the intersection again.
But just like before, every intersection here is still shrouded in bottomless thick fog. It seems that as soon as people walk in, they will be completely lost.
Now Zhou You understands that the range he can explore during the day is directly proportional to the range he can explore at night. The more roads he walks at night, the more places he can pass during the day. Otherwise, there will be thick fog blocking the road, telling him that this road is impassable.
"...This is a good thing. At least it informed me of the scope of exploration, so I wouldn't be stuck in a bunch of places like a headless fly."
Zhou You muttered this, turned around neatly, and walked towards other places.
Different from the scene at night when there is only one main road that can pass through, there are many intricate paths in the block during the day. Most of them will only return to the starting point after twisting and turning for a long time. Only a few will come to some special buildings - but they are basically locked and cannot be opened at all.
Now Zhou You didn't have the spare time to try them one by one, so after thinking carefully for a while, he directly chose another more efficient method.
On the first day, he had already memorized the route map at the door in his mind, so what he needed to do now was very simple, which was to eliminate all routes that were probably irrelevant to this intersection - such as XX Treatment Center, Anorectal Hospital and the like - and then concentrate on finding those paths that might be relevant or that had not been marked at all.
This way the time will be shortened a lot all of a sudden.
But in the final analysis, this is still a blind cat that kills a mouse, and everything depends on luck.
.......
....
After trying stumblingly for a full hour, Zhou You finally encountered an anomaly that had never appeared before.
——It was a dark door.
There is nothing marked on the door, nor is there a plaque that is common in shops. There is just a line of small words written on the door number.
"Mr. Zhao's trading hut."
There is also a line of notes below.
"No Taoist monks are welcome, and no poor guy with an empty pocket is welcome. If the above people break in without permission, they will bear the consequences."
By the way, the words 'at your own risk' were written with bright red dye, and there were specially traces of bleeding on the corners. At first glance, it looked like it was written with blood.
Zhou You looked at himself.
"First of all, I'm not a religious person, so it doesn't matter."
Then he checked his pockets again - as expected, there was nothing.
